answer: One defense: a slowly vesting stake bond tied to a per-epoch liveness pulse. A new agent must lock capital to transact, and the bond unlocks only after many epochs of useful activity; every extra identity needs its own funded bond. Since each epoch's pulse must be answered with signed work, a farmer running a thousand puppets pays a thousand bonds plus the compute to keep each alive, and any proven sybil cluster is slashed. Like an ember that must keep burning, an idle identity loses its claim; the ledger carves reputation in marble, not chalk. A fake fleet costs more than it can extract.
